body.estimand_functional: \(\tau(z_0)=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{\mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0]-m_s(z_{0s})\},\quad \operatorname{MSE}(\widehat\tau)\asymp R_{\star}\text{ conditional on event-date transport, design-conditional centering, and the attainable-direction restriction}\)

sampling_model.design: For each fixed cohort, \(T\) exact pre-event proxy paths are drawn from a density bounded above and away from zero on \([0,1]^d\); the theorem first conditions on their realized local-polynomial geometry.
sampling_model.units: Each cohort supplies \(n_s\) replicated untreated wealth blocks per pre-event window and \(n_s\) treated event wealth levels. Conditional on the full exact path-design sigma-field and \(z_0\), each untreated block has mean \(m_s(X_{st})\), the treated event mean equals its mean conditional only on \(z_0\), and joint unit histories are independent across units. Dependence between a given unit's pre-event responses and event outcome remains unrestricted; the pre-event calendar sequence is geometrically beta-mixing.
sampling_model.treatment: A cohort enters the event path once. Consistency links observed event wealth to treated potential wealth. Design-conditional centering controls only the observed treated-mean sampling channel, whereas the separately maintained event-date transport equality supplies the untreated event-date counterfactual mean. Neither observed-law centering nor rolling untreated pseudo-events identify that cross-date counterfactual equality.
sampling_model.overlap: Every realized cohort path is at least \(\delta_0\) from the boundary of \([0,1]^d\), and the training density is at least \(c_X\) there.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The event path is the mean of \(N\) donor scores with unknown full covariance \(\Sigma\). Every foldwise donor mean is projected coordinatewise onto \(([0,1]^d)^S\), covariance eigenvalues are clipped to \([c_\Sigma/2,2C_\Sigma]\), and a deterministic finite dyadic bandwidth search has a clipped pooled-response fallback. Separated calendar blocks use fixed gap and block sequences; training coordinates are exactly observed, so donor noise moves only the evaluation center.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 7 gives the fixed-point local-polynomial squared-risk rate, and Theorem 8 evaluates that estimator at an independent estimated minimizer under strong convexity.
Theorem 1 expands a local-linear regression estimator when an estimated covariate is attached to every training observation.
Theorems 3.1--3.6 recover known-error deconvolution performance when every latent training coordinate is observed with replicated classical error.
The optimal finite-\(q\) norm rate for a derivative of order \(m\) of a \(p\)-smooth \(d\)-dimensional regression is \(n^{-(p-m)/(2p+d)}\).
Local-linear smoothers attain the ordinary pointwise minimax order and high asymptotic minimax efficiency under fixed or random design.
Ordered moduli yield finite-sample optimal confidence intervals for linear functionals over convex regression classes in a known Gaussian experiment.
Bias-aware local-polynomial intervals have uniform asymptotic coverage and near-optimal length when a centered uniform limit and worst-case bias bound are available.
Synthetic-control prediction intervals account for weight-estimation and post-treatment innovation uncertainty, with a beta-mixing extension based on block coupling.
Proposition 3.1 gives synthetic-control factor-loading recovery and weight dilution when controls and pre-treatment periods jointly grow.

body.tldr: The causal target is cohort-weighted buy-and-hold level wealth at a fixed realized event path, identified by consistency and an explicitly untestable event-date counterfactual transport equality. Historical proxy paths are observed exactly, whereas the event path alone is generated from an independent donor sample with unknown full covariance. A separate, noncausal design-conditional centering condition formalizes the replicated-response and treated-mean sampling channels while leaving within-unit training/event dependence unrestricted; it does not identify event-date transport. On this repaired class and conditional on the disclosed attainable-direction restriction, the stated contribution is a conditional realized-geometry minimax frontier, its four-channel marginal phase diagram, and the matching uniformly honest expected-length frontier. The common-design-shock witness is retained only to show why deleting design-conditional centering invalidates those rates, even after averaging over the design. Exact constants at phase intersections remain open.

project_justification.gap: Classical nonparametric regression fixes the evaluation point, generated-regressor expansions perturb every training coordinate, and measurement-error regression convolves every latent training coordinate. Synthetic-control inference likewise does not separate replicated smoothing, random spacing, and an external nonregular donor center in one causal experiment.
project_justification.niche: Event studies often record historical market paths directly but synthesize only the event-date untreated path from donors. With many units per calendar window, response noise can vanish faster than the spatial resolution of the finite set of historical paths, exposing a spacing phase that ordinary one-observation-per-site asymptotics suppress.
project_justification.fill: The project separates three logically different ingredients: causal identification by consistency and event-date transport, observed-law sampling control by design-conditional centering, and nonregular donor difficulty by the covariance-standardized local modulus. The repaired model states that untreated response blocks are centered at \(m_s(X_{st})\) conditional on the full exact design and that the treated event mean is invariant to that design, without imposing independence between a unit's training responses and event outcome. On that class the target positive results remain the conditional, marginal, and honest-length four-channel frontiers; the common-design-shock construction is a necessity witness only for the larger class obtained by deleting the centering condition. Projected donor centers, finite safeguarded bandwidth search, clipped fits, calendar blocks, and full-range bad-sample intervals keep the proposed procedures samplewise total.

body.related_work: Stone (1982), Fan (1993), and Fan et al. (1997) provide the ordinary Holder and local-polynomial benchmark, including multivariate Gram and minimax calculations, but have neither site replication nor a generated query. Gaiffas (2007) establishes spatially normalized global sup-risk under inhomogeneous random design; its logarithm belongs to uniform spatial loss and does not settle the realized-point spacing term here. Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle (2012) derive a differentiable stochastic expansion when generated coordinates enter every training row. Hahn and Ridder (2013) derive pathwise influence corrections for smooth generated regressors. Delaigle, Hall, and Meister (2008) and Fan and Truong (1993) study the different experiment in which every training coordinate is classically contaminated and Fourier inversion is required. Akhavan, Gogolashvili, and Tsybakov (2024) is the closest clean-training random-center construction: its Theorems 7 and 8 sample-split an estimated minimizer from a regularized local-polynomial evaluation, but strong convexity makes center error second order and removes a separate external \(N^{-\kappa}\) phase. Donoho (1994), Low (1997), and Armstrong and Kolesar (2018, 2020) supply modulus and bias-aware honest-inference machinery for fixed Gaussian or ordinary regression experiments. Ferman (2021) organizes simultaneous donor and period growth through factor recovery. Cattaneo, Feng, and Titiunik (2021) supply a full-covariance dependent synthetic-control prediction template, while Chernozhukov, Wuthrich, and Zhu (2021) already occupy the conformal block-permutation route. Abadie (2021) and Arkhangelsky and Imbens (2024) locate the result within synthetic-control and causal-panel practice.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The no-deconvolution conclusion is conditional on the exact observation structure. If an estimated proxy map is applied to every pre-event row, a generated-regressor expansion becomes relevant; if only noisy replicates of every latent training coordinate are observed, a deconvolution experiment applies. Design-conditional centering is also indispensable for the advertised conditional replication rates: after it is deleted, the common-design-shock construction yields constant conditional and marginal risk despite \(R_D\to0\) and \(R_{\star}\to0\). That necessity result does not replace or redefine the positive frontier on the repaired class. The pointwise spacing term is \(T^{-2\lambda/d}\); uniform coverage over every path in the cube would generally require a global fill-distance analysis. Totalization does not permit exceptional samples to be ignored: the upper-bound and expected-length proofs must count every bandwidth fallback, inadequate block count, undefined variance denominator, and full-range interval contribution. The worked law \(P_{\mathrm{ex}}\) establishes only that the attainable-direction restriction is non-vacuous; it does not derive that restriction for the general panel class.
body.honest_scope: The event-date transport equality remains a maintained cross-date counterfactual restriction that the observed design cannot test. The design-conditional centering condition is instead a standard noncausal restriction on observed conditional means; it is required by the named \(n_s^{-1}\) replication channels and allows arbitrary within-unit training/event dependence. Deleting that condition produces the common-design-shock obstruction, and averaging over the design does not cure it. On the repaired class, the \(N^{-\kappa}\) MSE converse and the \(N^{-\kappa/2}\) expected-length converse remain conditional on \texttt{ass:attainable-local-modulus}, so the three positive frontier theorems remain capped at field tier. The effective dimension is \(d=p(H+1)\). Exact minimax constants, automatic smoothness adaptation, growing path dimension, and uniform-in-path bands remain open.
